_comment: FUNDI PAY — providers za malipo. Kanuni: credentials hazipo kwenye code (env vars tu). Provider yenye 'mode': stk = API halisi; manual = USSD/malipo ya mkononi + confirm kwa reference; http = aggregator (weka endpoint + creds env).

business._note_sw: Kabla ya kupokea malipo kama BIASHARA: BRELA (jina la biashara), TIN (TRA), namba ya simu ya kampuni. Aggregator (Selcom/Baobab/Flutterwave) inahitaji ile pia. BOT PSP license ni tu kama unapokea kwa ajili ya watu wengine.

providers.name: M-Pesa (Vodacom)
providers.notes_sw: Daraja Express (STK push): mteja anapokea prompt kwenye simu → anaweka PIN. Inahitaji Daraja app credentials.

providers.name: Tigo Pesa / Mixx by Yas
providers.notes_sw: Mteja anatumia USSD au app kutuma kwa namba yako; thibitisha kwa SMS/confirmation code kwenye UI. API ya moja kwa moja inahitaji kampuni iliyosajiliwa (aggregator au Yas merchant).

providers.name: Airtel Money
providers.notes_sw: Kama tigo: USSD/app + confirm kwa reference. Merchant API kupitia Airtel Business.

providers.name: Halo Pesa
providers.notes_sw: HaloPesa merchant API ipo kwa kampuni; kwa sasa manual + confirm.

providers.name: Benki (CRDB / NMB)
providers.notes_sw: Malipo ya benki (kwa makampuni): mteja/kampuni inalipa kwenye account yako; thibitisha kwenye statement/alert, weka reference ya slip.

providers.name: Kadi / Kimataifa (Flutterwave/Paystack)
providers.notes_sw: Kwa wateja wa nje ya Tanzania: aggregator (Flutterwave n.k.) inatoa card + PayPal + Apple Pay. Weka endpoint + key kwenye env.

providers.name: Cash (fedha taslimu)
providers.notes_sw: Pokea fedha, andika namba ya receipt kwenye confirm.
